QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` on, both `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `_FREE_MACRO` set | your macros, as compile-time aliases" and "Option A, compile time" / "Option B, runtime ... `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free)`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer pair, but it never says the two are mutually exclusive. The table rows imply that the macros take precedence over the pointers, but that is not an explicit statement.
